name: chinese-idiom-chain-game
description: 大字體、離線優先、可安裝至手機的繁體中文成語填字闖關 PWA。

scripts.build: npm run build:data && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:data && npm run test:index && npm run test:game && npm run test:loader && npm run test:pwa && npm run test:puzzle && npm run test:progress && npm run test:media && npm run test:bonus-energy && npm run test:game-bonus && npm run test:bonus-question && npm run test:bonus-round && npm run test:bonus-reward
scripts.test:puzzle: npm run compile:core && node --test tests/puzzle-board.test.mjs tests/puzzle-engine.test.mjs tests/puzzle-levels.test.mjs
scripts.test:progress: npm run compile:core && node --test tests/progress-engine.test.mjs tests/progress-serialization.test.mjs tests/progress-write-queue.test.mjs
